title: Course Review
description: The closing wrap-up of Containers & CI/CD: two cumulative review pages that retrieve and apply both modules in new scenarios, followed by the course's graded multiple-choice final listed in course.json assessments.
sourceCoverageNotes: Learner-facing label: every course ends with a module titled exactly 'Course Review'; this module is the Containers & CI/CD instance, with the course-scoped id containers-cicd-course-review.
Inventory of mixed teaching/review modules: none. Neither containers-and-compose nor microservices-and-ci-cd contains a review topic. Nothing is moved, regrouped or re-pathed.

Both topics here are new Course Review assets, not syllabus rows: each maps no curriculum pointer and adds nothing to the canonical topic count. containers-cicd-review-images-and-compose reviews containers-and-compose; containers-cicd-review-services-and-pipelines reviews microservices-and-ci-cd. No graded check depends on the optional jenkins-registries-cd-and-kubernetes reading or on module-lab material. Every concept they use is taught earlier and listed in their topic.json prerequisites.

Order at the course end: the two taught modules, then this Course Review module (its two pages in order), then the distinct course-level graded multiple-choice final listed in course.json assessments. Course Review pages are ungraded practice and carry no GIFT.

Workbook placement: the Standard and Fast rows 'Course Review: cumulative review and scenario page 1' and 'page 2' map to containers-cicd-review-images-and-compose and containers-cicd-review-services-and-pipelines in that order. No course time fit or calendar change is claimed here.
